```artifact
Feature: Embedded Controller Functional Tests

  Scenario: Controller responds fast enough to prevent pressure dropping below -4cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the pressure is at -5cm
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the pressure should not drop below -4cm within 1 second

  Scenario: Controller never commands pressure above 60
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the commanded pressure is 61cm
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the commanded pressure should not exceed 60cm

  Scenario: SW measures PEEP over each breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And a breath is initiated
    When the breath is completed
    Then the PEEP should be measured and recorded

  Scenario: Controller hits commanded values within 10%
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the commanded pressure is 50cm
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the actual pressure should be within 5cm of the commanded pressure

  Scenario: Controller triggers inspiration cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the oxygen level is low
    When the controller detects a need for oxygen
    Then the inspiration cycle should be triggered

  Scenario: Controller triggers expiration cycle
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the carbon dioxide level is high
    When the controller detects a need for expiration
    Then the expiration cycle should be triggered

  Scenario: Controller meets PIP targets in range 5-55cmH2O +/- 5cm
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the PIP target is 10cm
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the actual pressure should be within 5cm of the PIP target

  Scenario: Controller meets commanded breath rate within +- 1 breath
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the commanded breath rate is 10 breaths per minute
    When the controller is commanded to increase breath rate
    Then the actual breath rate should be within 1 breath of the commanded breath rate

  Scenario Outline: Controller responds to invalid inputs
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the commanded pressure is <pressure>
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the controller should respond with an error message

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | -10cm   |
      | 61cm    |
      | 100cm   |

  Scenario Outline: Controller responds to edge cases
    Given the controller is in normal operation mode
    And the commanded pressure is <pressure>
    When the controller is commanded to increase pressure
    Then the controller should respond with the expected outcome

    Examples:
      | pressure |
      | 0cm     |
      | 60cm    |
      | 5cm     |
```
